title: Knightmare: Iblee's Nightmare (lore build)
summary: Knightmare has almost no Main Deck of its own, so this list builds one from the World Legacy story (Master Guide 6). Every outside card is a character or moment from the chapter in which Lee takes over Ib's body as Knightmare Corruptor Iblee and forges the Knightmares from the cores of the Mekk-Knights.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: Six Mekk-Knights: each Knightmare was made from one of their cores. Red Moon became Phoenix, Orange Sunset Cerberus, Yellow Star Unicorn, Indigo Eclipse Mermaid, Green Horizon Goblin and Purple Nightfall Gryphon. Mekk-Knight Blue Sky is left out; its core never became a Knightmare.
Lee the World Chalice Fairy and Crowned by the World Chalice (Ib): together they become Iblee. Lee searches Crowned on Normal or Special Summon.
World Legacy Spells and Traps from the Iblee chapter: Secret (Iblee's birth), Succession, Awakens, Struggle, Sorrow and Nightmare. World Legacy Monstrosity is from the Idlee chapter.
In the Extra Deck, the World Chalice heroes who fought the Knightmares: Ningirsu, Imduk, and Ib herself before the corruption.

summary.title: Opening: Lee or Mekk-Knight Purple Nightfall + Knightmare Corruptor Iblee
steps: Set a Spell or Trap into a column to Special Summon Mekk-Knight Purple Nightfall, banish it to search another Mekk-Knight, or Normal Summon Lee the World Chalice Fairy to search Crowned by the World Chalice.

Link Summon Knightmare Phoenix or Knightmare Cerberus into the Extra Monster Zone using two monsters with different names, then Normal Summon or revive Knightmare Corruptor Iblee so it points to your Link Monster (or is pointed to by it) for a co-link.

When Iblee is sent from your field to the GY as Link Material for Knightmare Unicorn or Ib the World Chalice Priestess, Special Summon Iblee to the opponent's field in Defense Position to lock them out of non-Link Special Summons.

summary.title: Extra Deck: Knightmares & World Chalice
points: Knightmare Phoenix, Knightmare Cerberus, and Knightmare Unicorn discard a card on Link Summon to destroy a Spell/Trap, destroy a Special Summoned Main Monster, or shuffle any card into the Deck—and each draws a card if co-linked when activated.
While co-linked, Knightmare Phoenix protects your monsters from battle destruction and Knightmare Cerberus protects them from card effect destruction.

Imduk the World Chalice Dragon turns Crowned by the World Chalice into a Link-1 with an extra World Chalice Normal Summon, Ib the World Chalice Priestess protects co-linked partners, and Ningirsu the World Chalice Warrior sends a card from each side to the GY without targeting.

Once total Link Rating on the field reaches 8 or more, Knightmare Incarnation Idlee Special Summons itself from the hand as a Quick Effect and sends all Link Monsters on the field to the GY if the opponent controls more LinkMonsters.

summary.title: World Legacy Spells & Traps
points: World Legacy Succession revives any monster from your GY into a zone a Link Monster points to, immediately setting up co-links.

World Legacy's Sorrow negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation while you control a co-linked monster, and World Legacy Struggle destroys opposing Spells/Traps up to the number of co-linked monsters on the field.

World Legacy Awakens Link Summons during the opponent's turn, World Legacy's Secret revives a Level 5+ Mekk-Knight or Idlee while negating monster effects in its column, and World Legacy's Nightmare lets co-linked monsters battle without taking damage while shifting Knightmares between zones.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Knightmare Goblin, Knightmare Gryphon, and Knightmare Mermaid are Forbidden in the TCG. Orcust Knightmare (Galatea transformed) fits the story, but its effect requires other DARK Machine monsters, so it is omitted here.

main: Lee in Ib's body: revives a Link to point at it; locks you to Link summons.
Summons itself at 8 total Link Rating; sends every Link to the GY if they have more.
Gryphon's source: summons itself in a busy column; searches a Mekk-Knight.
Phoenix's source: summons itself in a busy column; destroys a monster there.
Cerberus's source: summons itself in a busy column; calls another Mekk-Knight.
Unicorn's source: summons itself in a busy column; destroys a Spell/Trap there.
Mermaid's source: summons itself in a busy column; moves a Mekk-Knight.
Goblin's source: summons itself in a busy column; recovers a Mekk-Knight.
The spirit that became Iblee: searches Crowned; returns from the GY.
Ib, the body Lee took: a Level 2 Normal for Imduk.
Knightmare Field Spell: no battle damage from co-linked monsters; moves Knightmares.
Revives any monster into a zone a Link points to.
Idlee's chapter: summons a Level 9, such as Idlee, from the hand.
Negates a card or effect while you control a co-linked monster.
Destroys Spells/Traps, one per co-linked monster.
Iblee's birth: revives a Level 5+ monster; negates effects in Mekk-Knight columns.
extra: Link-3 from Yellow Star's core: discards to shuffle a card away; extra draws when co-linked.
Link-2 from Red Moon's core: discards to destroy a Spell/Trap.
Link-2 from Orange Sunset's core: discards to destroy a Special Summoned monster.
Link-3 of two Links: the hero who struck down Knightmare Mermaid.
Link-2: Ib before Lee took her over.
Link-1 from Crowned: the dragon that broke Lee's hold on Ib.
